intro: The whole villa is yours: nothing here is shared with other guests. Three bedrooms sleeping up to seven, a private nine metre pool, and a fully equipped kitchen.

groups.title: Access
items: Bedroom and bathroom on the ground floor
groups.note: Please get in touch before booking if anyone in your party has limited mobility, so we can tell you honestly whether the villa will suit.

rules.title: Check in
rules.text: 2:00pm to 8:00pm. Please let us know your arrival time in advance.

rules.title: Check out
rules.text: 8:00am to 11:00am. Later check out is sometimes possible, subject to availability.

rules.title: Payment
rules.text: Payment before arrival by bank transfer. We will send instructions once your dates are confirmed. The balance is paid on arrival.

rules.title: Security deposit
rules.text: €100 on arrival, refunded in full at check out subject to an inspection of the villa.

rules.title: Children
rules.text: Children of all ages are welcome and there is no minimum age for check in. One crib is available on request, free of charge, subject to availability.

rules.title: Cancellation
rules.text: Terms depend on the season and the dates booked. Send us your dates and we will set out exactly what applies.

rules.title: Smoking
rules.text: The villa is entirely non smoking, indoors and out.

rules.title: Pets
rules.text: We are not able to accept pets.
